title: Kya kare bemaar
body:
kya kare bemaar sughra dil jo ghabraya kare
baap maa bhai behan ki yaad tadpaya kare
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushi shadi mein akbar ki bulayenge zaroor
hasratein allah sabke dil ki bar laaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh lene ki tamanna dil mein lab par ye dua
sar pe bhai ke bandhe sehra behan saaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
badke kismat ne kaha poori na hongi hasratein
hai likha hamsheer bin bhai ki kehlaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi bewa dulhan ek raat ki wa hasrata
phool umeedon ka khil kar yun na murjhaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay sarwar sada do ay ali akbar mujhe
thokare kab tak sare maidan padar khaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali jhoola dekh kar asghar ka kehti hai rabab
maut gar aaye to pehle maa ko aa jaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi aisa nahi aalam mein juz tere hussain
shukre haq karte huwe gardan ko katwaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon se us ghadi moo apna dholena qamar
jab musibat karbala ki yaad aajaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
author: Qamar Jalalvi
